privacyModal.title: Privacy Policy and Data Protection
privacyModal.subtitle: EU GDPR (Regulation 2016/679) & Swiss FADP (nLPD)
privacyModal.calloutDesc: At FatturaFacile, privacy is built directly into local architecture: zero data is sent to external servers or third parties.
privacyModal.section1Text: When using the Windows desktop application on your PC or USB drive:
section1Bullets: Accounting Data Processing: The desktop application does not transmit any entered data (customer books, amounts, invoices, bank accounts) to external servers or third parties.
Local Database: All records are stored strictly on your local device via SQLite. The business owner acts as the sole Data Controller.
No Telemetry: Zero invasive telemetry, background analytics, or activity tracking.
privacyModal.section2Text: Regarding visits to this informational website:
section2Bullets: Traffic Logs: Standard network logs (anonymized IP, user-agent) maintained strictly for infrastructure security and abuse prevention.
No Profiling Cookies: No advertising tracking or third-party behavioral profiling.
Contact Channels: The info@fatturafacile.eu email is used solely for voluntary technical and organizational replies.
privacyModal.section3Title: Section C: Data Subject Rights & Compliance
privacyModal.section3Text: Under Articles 15-22 of EU GDPR and Articles 25-29 of Swiss FADP, individuals retain full rights of access, rectification, portability, and erasure.

faq.searchPlaceholder: Search for an answer (e.g. backup, QR-bill, price)...

items.question: Is it really free?
items.answer: Yes. FatturaFacile is open source software under the MIT licence: you use it for free, with no subscription and no hidden costs. The code is public.

items.question: Where is my data?
items.answer: In the web version it is on the server where the program is installed: if you install it, it is on your server. In the upcoming Windows app it is only on your computer. The demo holds sample data only.

items.question: How do I make a backup?
items.answer: The web version makes an automatic copy every night and keeps the last 7. You can also make one by hand, download it and restore it whenever you want.

items.question: Does it send the invoice straight to the Italian tax system (SdI)?
items.answer: FatturaFacile creates the electronic invoice file (FatturaPA, XML format). To send it you can upload it to the free Fatture e Corrispettivi portal of the Italian Revenue Agency, or give it to your accountant.

items.question: How does it work for Switzerland?
items.answer: The invoice includes the payment slip with QR code (QR-bill), in the format Swiss banks require. It works with QR-IBAN and with a normal IBAN, in Swiss francs or euros, with Swiss VAT rates.

items.question: Can I ask for a feature or help out?
items.answer: Yes. Write to us in the Telegram group or open an issue on GitHub. We are also looking for people to translate, test the program or check the tax rules.

items.question: How do I try it?
items.answer: Open the online demo: it is the real program with sample data, no sign-up. Do not enter real data, because it is erased from time to time.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: For tradespeople, small businesses and freelancers in Italy and Switzerland who make quotes and invoices and do not want to pay a subscription.

storia.heading: From listening on job sites to the freedom of open software
storia.lead: FatturaFacile was not conceived in a corporate boardroom to maximize recurring ARR, but by observing the daily struggles of plumbers, electricians, and independent contractors battling bloated, slow, and expensive software.
storia.problemText: In recent years, the business software market forced an aggressive shift toward continuous subscription SaaS models. For enterprise supply chains with extensive warehousing, this overhead may be justifiable; for solo contractors and local service providers, it introduced disproportionate costs, confusing menus filled with unused buttons, and constant anxiety over losing access to records when offline or unsubscribed.

philosophyBullets.title: Radical Simplicity
philosophyBullets.desc: A straightforward workflow that gets straight to business: customer details, work description, accurate tax calculations, and one-click PDF generation.

philosophyBullets.title: Personal Data Sovereignty
philosophyBullets.desc: The database is a single file residing in your hands. No behavioral tracking, zero telemetry, and no storage on unverified third-party servers.

philosophyBullets.title: Full Swiss & Italian Compliance
philosophyBullets.desc: Engineered from day one for comprehensive nationwide regulatory compliance: Swiss QR-Bill (SIX standard), ESTV VAT, and revLPD across all cantons, plus Italian SdI e-invoicing (FatturaPA B2B/B2C, AgID), split payment, and withholding taxes across all regions.

philosophyBullets.title: Community Contribution
philosophyBullets.desc: Code and executable binaries remain entirely free so that apprentices and new entrepreneurs can launch their businesses without operational software debt.

timeline.title: First Field Prototypes
timeline.desc: Initial C# prototype utilizing embedded SQLite to address the need for fast, offline, USB-portable billing on construction sites.

timeline.title: Full Dual-Market Compliance
timeline.desc: Integration of certified XML generation for Italian FatturaPA (SDI) and official Swiss SIX QR-Bill standards with dedicated VAT rates.

timeline.title: Public Open-Source Release & Educational Initiative
timeline.desc: Public launch of the GitHub repository, rollout of academic partnerships with vocational schools, and establishment of the national partner directory.

seo.title: FatturaFacile Privacy & GDPR/nLPD – Offline-first Open Source ERP (Switzerland QR-Bill & Italy SdI)
seo.description: Transparent privacy policy for FatturaFacile Open Source (MIT) ERP: zero telemetry, EU GDPR & Swiss FADP (nLPD) compliance, and 100% local Offline-first SQLite data ownership.
seo.keywords: fatturafacile privacy, gdpr swiss fadp nlpd, offline-first sqlite privacy, zero telemetry open source erp

privacy.subtitle: EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR 2016/679) & Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP).
privacy.calloutText: At FatturaFacile, accounting data privacy is not a bureaucratic requirement but the architectural cornerstone of the software.
privacy.section1Intro: When using the standalone Windows desktop application (WPF/.NET with local SQLite database):

section1Bullets.title: Accounting Data Processing
section1Bullets.desc: The desktop application does not transmit any entered data (customer contacts, amounts, invoices, bank accounts) to external servers or third parties.

section1Bullets.title: Local Database
section1Bullets.desc: All records are stored strictly on the user's local computer via SQLite. The user is the sole Data Controller of their business records.

section1Bullets.title: Telemetry
section1Bullets.desc: Zero invasive telemetry, background analytics, or activity tracking inside the software.

privacy.section2Intro: Regarding visits and interactions on this public website:

section2Bullets.title: Browsing Logs
section2Bullets.desc: Standard network connection logs (anonymized IP, user-agent) managed solely for infrastructure security and abuse prevention.

section2Bullets.title: Cookies
section2Bullets.desc: Zero profiling cookies, marketing pixels, or third-party advertising trackers.

section2Bullets.title: Contact Channels
section2Bullets.desc: The contact email address (info@fatturafacile.eu) is utilized exclusively for voluntary technical and organizational replies.

privacy.section3Title: Section C: Data Subject Rights (GDPR & Swiss FADP)
privacy.section3Intro: In accordance with Articles 15-22 of EU GDPR 2016/679 and Articles 25-29 of the Swiss Federal Act on Data Protection (FADP):

section3Bullets.title: Access and Portability
section3Bullets.desc: Because the database uses standard SQLite format, the data owner can extract or export the raw document database at any time without proprietary lock-in.

section3Bullets.title: Rectification and Erasure
section3Bullets.desc: Every customer card, draft, or quotation can be amended or deleted directly inside the user interface in real time.

section3Bullets.title: Statutory Tax Preservation
section3Bullets.desc: Legally compliant long-term retention of electronic XML invoices submitted to Italian SdI is fulfilled through official tax authority channels or your chartered accountant.

privacy.section4Text: For any questions regarding security architecture or technical suggestions for privacy enhancements:

flow.title: From issue to release
flow.lead: The same workflow for every repository. Automated checks (lint, tests and build) run on every pull request.

steps.title: Pick an issue
steps.desc: Start from an open issue (the "good first issue" ones are a good start) or open a new one, and mention it in the Telegram group.

steps.title: Create a branch
steps.desc: Organisation members work on a branch of the repository; everyone else uses a fork.

steps.title: Open a pull request
steps.desc: Against the dev branch (on repositories that have one, otherwise main), with a clear description of what changes and why.

steps.title: Review
steps.desc: At least one approval and green checks are required. After the merge, the changes show up in the development environment.

steps.title: Release
steps.desc: When dev is stable it moves to main; versions are released with a tag (vX.Y.Z).

hero.title: Need a specific feature or a custom module?
hero.descPost: for information or to describe your business needs.
hero.descStrong: We will build the custom feature or module at no cost (FREE)
hero.descEnd: and integrate it directly into upcoming public releases to make it available to all craftspeople in the community.

steps.title: How it works in 3 simple steps

items.title: 1. Write to us
items.desc: Tell us about your workflow and what you need (e.g. a particular invoice layout, a field for specific withholdings, or handling of complex items).

items.title: 2. Development at €0
items.desc: We implement the code for free in the C#/.NET WPF project or in the cloud Web API, with automated tests and high security standards.

items.title: 3. Released for Everyone
items.desc: The new version is published on GitHub and on fatturafacile.eu. You get what you need without spending a cent, and you help all your colleagues in the trade.

roles.title: How to Contribute to the Project
roles.lead: You do not need to be a senior developer to make a difference: every contribution that improves the experience for tradespeople is valuable.

items.title: C# / .NET & Astro Developers
items.desc: Contribute to the WPF desktop client or to the documentation frontend and Astro website. Clean Architecture, MVVM pattern and robust unit tests.

items.title: Accountants & Fiduciary Firms (IT/CH)
items.desc: Help us validate the SDI XML schemas for Italy and the SIX QR-Bill guidelines for Switzerland to ensure 100% compliance with no surprises.

items.title: Multilingual Translators (IT, EN, FR, DE)
items.desc: Switzerland and Europe speak many languages. Help refine the application texts and information pages in French, German and English.

items.title: Tradespeople & Field Beta Testers
items.desc: Use the preview versions on the job site, in the workshop or in the van and tell us what could be made even faster or more practical in everyday use.
